column1: # Accepted findings for the weekly ZAP baseline scan (.github/workflows/dast.yml). Format, tab separated:
# IGNORE hides the rule from the scan summary AND from the high-risk gate. Rules not listed here are reported as WARN; only HIGH-risk
# alerts fail the run. Every line needs a reason and an owner decision in the pull request that adds it; remove it when the cause is fixed.

column3: Storable and Cacheable Content: static SPA assets and JSON API responses are cacheable by design; index.html is served no-cache
Sec-Fetch-* headers missing: a request header the browser sends, nothing the response can fix
User Agent Fuzzer: informational, the app answers every user agent the same way by design
